subject: Re: Urgent — same-day demo tonight (CEST) / availability
messages:
From: Sofie Håkansson <sofie.h@cloudbridge.io>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Cc: Tom Berger <tom.berger@cloudbridge.io>
Date: Sun, 29 Mar 2026 08:42:00 +0100
Subject: Urgent — same-day demo tonight (CEST)

Hi Laura,

Apologies for the late note — the exec team at CloudBridge has a sudden slot this evening (19:00 CEST) to see a short 30-min walkthrough before a board meeting. Would Redwood be able to do a same-day demo at that time? We realize this is outside normal hours for your US team; if you can’t do it, could you point us to someone who can cover a late slot?

Quick context: we’re evaluating infra options for inference and want to see dedicated capacity performance and multi-region routing. I’ve attached our RFP and a proposed agenda.

Thanks,
Sofie Håkansson
Head of Platform
CloudBridge
Attachment: CloudBridge-proposal.pdf

From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: Sofie Håkansson <sofie.h@cloudbridge.io>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, rafael_mendes@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 29 Mar 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Urgent — same-day demo tonight (CEST)

Hi Sofie — thanks for the note and the RFP. Really appreciate the short notice heads-up.

Short answer: we can cover a late session tonight, but I need to confirm coverage with my colleagues (we'll rotate to cover after-hours demos when needed). Two quick asks to lock this down:
- Can you confirm whether the 19:00 time is CEST (UTC+1) or CEST/CEST vs CEST/CEST — I want to be sure we align on DST.
- Is the desired session 30m focused on dedicated capacity + routing, or do you want a short Q&A at the end?

Proposed option I can offer while I confirm team coverage: 19:00 CEST / 10:00 PDT tonight — we can do a 30-min live demo focused on throughput and routing, followed by 10 mins Q&A. If that works I’ll send a calendar invite (ICS) and loop in Marissa and Rafael for coverage.

I’ve cc’d Marissa (solutions) and Rafael (SE) to confirm they can join. If neither can join live, we can run the demo and record for the execs.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com

From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, rafael_mendes@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 29 Mar 2026 10:30:00 -0700
Subject: FW: Urgent — same-day demo tonight (CEST)

Marissa / Rafael — forwarding a request from CloudBridge. Exec team wants a 30-min demo tonight at 19:00 CEST (that’s 10:00 PDT). I proposed 19:00 CEST / 10:00 PDT and offered to record if we can’t cover live. Can one of you take lead on the demo? Rafael, can you run the dedicated capacity throughput portion (benchmarks + routing)? Marissa, can you cover onboarding and commercial Qs if Rafael is on technical?

If you both can’t do it live, we’ll do a short run-through and send a recording. The customer expects a quick turnaround — they’re meeting with their board.

Thanks — please reply ASAP so I can send an invite.
— Laura

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, rafael_mendes@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 29 Mar 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FW: Urgent — same-day demo tonight (CEST)

I can cover the onboarding/commercial flow and will join live. Rafael — can you confirm you can do the 10:00 PDT slot to run the throughput/routing demo? If not I can run a shortened technical demo using the pre-recorded perf clips and we’ll do live Q&A.

Also note: last time CloudBridge ran into confusion around DST labels (CEST vs CET). The calendar invite should explicitly state timezone and UTC offset to avoid mismatch — e.g., "19:00 CEST (UTC+1) / 10:00 PDT (UTC-7)". I’ll prep the invite and attach the ICS.

Marissa

From: rafael_mendes@redwood.com
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, Sofie Håkansson <sofie.h@cloudbridge.io>
Date: Sun, 29 Mar 2026 19:10:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Urgent — same-day demo tonight (CEST) — confirmed

Hi all — confirmed: I can do the 19:00 CEST / 10:00 PDT slot tonight. Laura / Marissa — I’ll lead the live throughput demo and routing failover examples (20m) and leave 10m for Q&A.

Sofie — we’ll send an invite in the next 5–10 minutes with the explicit UTC offsets included. I’ll also attach a short perf deck and the ICS for your calendar. Looking forward to it.

Regards,
Rafael Mendes
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
Attachment: demo-invite.ics
